# Identity A prompt set

## A01 neutral daylight

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a completely fictional East Asian woman around age 28 who does not resemble a public figure. Plain neutral light-gray wall. One person only. Centered straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait. Natural black hair tied back, dark brown eyes, forehead, cheeks, jawline, eyes, hairline and chin fully visible. Neutral expression. No makeup, jewelry or glasses. Highly photorealistic unretouched smartphone photo with visible pores and natural skin variation. Eye-level portrait framing; face occupies 30 to 35 percent of image; shoulders and both ears visible. Soft indirect neutral daylight around 5500K, even across both sides of face, correct exposure and neutral white balance. Plain medium-gray crew-neck shirt. Accurate anatomy, one face, no beauty filter, no skin smoothing, no cinematic grading, no text, watermark, logo, bangs, strong shadow or colored background.

## A02 warm indoor

Image A01 is the edit target and immutable identity reference. Change only capture lighting: ordinary warm indoor LED around 3200K, mild warm cast and slightly dimmer exposure. Preserve exact identity, skin characteristics, hairstyle, hair and eye color, expression, pose, camera angle, crop, gray shirt, background, anatomy and lack of makeup. Do not alter underlying skin tone; only illumination and camera white-balance appearance may change.

## A03 cool screen

Image A01 is the edit target and immutable identity reference. Change only capture lighting: cool laptop or phone screen around 7000K in a dim neutral room, mild cool-blue cast and slightly lower exposure, still clear enough for face analysis. Preserve exact identity, skin characteristics, hairstyle, hair and eye color, expression, pose, camera angle, crop, gray shirt, background, anatomy and lack of makeup. Do not alter underlying skin tone; only illumination and camera white-balance appearance may change.
